title: Financial Assistance Policy, Section 7 — Complete Applications and Supporting Documents
content:
**7.1 Completeness.** Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), an application is complete when it carries the patient's signed attestation (where the tier requires the attestation) and every document type in the tier's required list has been accepted (counted as the distinct required document types with an accepted entry on the case); any one of the accepted proof-of-income documents satisfies proof of income. *The words "every document type in the tier's required list has been accepted" are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis; the attestation requirement and the proof-of-income rule remain in force.*

**7.2 Missing information.** An incomplete application receives a missing-information notice listing each missing document as requested. *The clause "the documents due date is the notice date plus the missing-information response days, in calendar days" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.*

**7.3** A document is logged once per status.

**7.4 Denial for incompleteness.** An application may be denied for the reason "incomplete after deadline" only after the response deadline counted from the missing-information notice has passed. Count calendar days starting the day after the notice date; the deadline day itself still belongs to the patient, so denial is possible from the following day. The deadline is read from Riverbend's record of the notice on the case.

**7.5** Complete applications are determined within the determination days.

**7.6** Because the application period runs longer than the response deadline, documents received after an incomplete denial but inside the application period reopen the case by reconsideration.

### Boundary of 7.4 (hypothetical deadline day)

| Day | Denial as incomplete after deadline |
|---|---|
| the deadline day itself | not yet possible — the day still belongs to the patient |
| the day after the deadline day | possible |

### Document log (7.3)

Each document type is logged once in each status (requested, received, accepted, rejected) on a case; a second entry of the same type in the same status on the same case is not logged.

superseded_clauses: every document type in the tier's required_document_types has been ACCEPTED
documents_due_date is the notice date plus missing_information_response_days calendar days
